## Invoice Status (IS)

**Consume, don't rebuild.** Invoice's status is the shared PaymentStatusField, re-exported from invoice.gts under its invoice-side name. The AP (buy-side) leg is now SHIPPED as the one deliberate widening this Spec previously planned: received → matching → matched / exception → approved-for-payment, joining the existing sell-side ladder at partial/paid. Existing sell-side values and transitions are untouched; the transition graph carries both legs on the owning module (payment-status-field.gts).

### Example

A primitive enum cannot carry containedExamples — see the linked vendor invoice INV N-4471 (status: matching) and the sell-side INV-2026-114 (status: sent).

### Non-goals

No parallel AP-only status field — one ladder, extended once, on the owning module. Edit dropdowns on sell-side invoices now list the AP values too; that is the documented cost of one shared ladder.
